headline: DEA places experimental opioid-withdrawal drug SR-17018 in Schedule I
summary: The DEA has classified SR-17018, a compound some opioid users credit with easing withdrawal symptoms, as a Schedule I drug alongside heroin. Users on Reddit and Discord say the substance helped them quit, while researchers warn the scheduling could halt further study of it as a potential opioid treatment.
